description: This file is the entry point and bootstrap code for the OpenCart framework, responsible for initializing core components such as autoloading, configuration, registry, request/response handling, database, session, cache, templating, language, URL handling, event system, routing, and execution flow.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Autoloader
classes.description: Handles class autoloading based on registered namespaces and directories.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Registry
classes.description: Serves as a container for application-wide objects, facilitating dependency injection and sharing.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Config
classes.description: Manages configuration settings, loading from files, and providing configuration values.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Log
classes.description: Provides logging capabilities, writing messages to log files.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Event
classes.description: Event system enabling registration and triggering of events/hooks.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Action
classes.description: Represents an executable action or controller route.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating objects within the framework.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Loader
classes.description: Handles loading of controllers, models, and libraries.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Response
classes.description: Manages HTTP response output and headers.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\DB
classes.description: Database connection and query execution class.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Session
classes.description: Session handling class for user session data.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Cache
classes.description: Caching system for storing temporary data.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Document
classes.description: Handles document properties such as title, metadata, etc.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a namespace and directory for autoloading.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value object in the registry.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a language or template path.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new session or resumes existing one.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a message to the log file.
